description: Native Enyo search-aware preflight: start from the best Enyo-owned SF-binpack checkpoint and train a non-mate move-choice objective with broad init distillation as the guardrail.
hypothesis: Scalar SF-binpack continuation improved mate-like behavior but failed non-mate move choice. A search-aware objective weighted toward non-mate targets may improve engine-search choices while broad init distillation prevents broad behavior drift.
backend_note: search-aware PyTorch path is used because Bullet does not yet implement the multi-child search objective
gates: net-diff must show intentional exported movement, not an identical net
fresh-hash search gate must improve non-mate capped diff without reopening mate-like tails
static validation is only a rejection filter
failure-suite replay is required before any SPRT

validation.result: rejected; net-diff moved only 191/512 L2 weights and 24/32 L2 biases, target top1 stayed around 32-33/232, and fresh-hash 300k search gate collapsed: candidate_better=31, reference_better=151, capped_sum_diff_cp=-20372
validation.next: audit train_search_aware.py on a tiny target-only overfit before changing build.json again; no SPRT
